content: NIH study (July 2026, covered by ScienceDaily, EurekAlert, News-Medical, Medical Daily): four AI photo-based calorie apps underestimated meal calories by ~250-345 kcal on average, roughly one-third of actual content; fat was underestimated by ~30g; high-fat dishes (e.g. ketogenic meals) had the largest errors. Confirms LLM/model estimation must be treated as a rough estimate, explicitly labeled as such, with user correction paths, never as catalog-grade data.
